context: A mom and son chat about a season
purpose: Teach: イルミネーション/ろうそく/洋食/新緑/売れ筋/ロース/ファンクラブ/家族連れ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、街のイルミネーション、見に行こう!
lines.en: Mom, let's go see the city's illuminations!
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Quick attack on the opening word. Bouncing energy — the urgency of a child who wants something *now*. Warm and unguarded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お部屋でも、ろうそく灯して、夜の雰囲気、楽しもうね。
lines.en: Yes. We can light candles at home too, and enjoy the nighttime atmosphere together.
lines.style: Warm and deliberate. Accepting his enthusiasm while gently introducing her own quieter version. Soft, almost singing the rhythm. A mother remapping his energy into something they can share.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 今夜の夕飯、洋食のお店、行きたいなあ。
lines.en: And tonight for dinner — can we go to a Western restaurant?
lines.style: Hopeful rise at the end. Trying something new alongside his first request. The small gamble of a quiet child testing what his mother might say yes to.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 春になったら、新緑の中、ピクニックね。
lines.en: When spring comes, we'll have a picnic in the fresh green.
lines.style: Tender but grounded. She's not saying no — she's saying *and*. Soft landing on each phrase. The confidence of a mother who knows her son, remapping the seasons.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お店、売れ筋のおもちゃ、見に行きたい。
lines.en: And I want to go see the best-selling toys at the shops.
lines.style: Gentle persistence. He's building a list now, not asking all at once. Quiet certainty — the rhythm of a child who trusts he's being heard.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんの好物、ロースカツ、作ろうか。
lines.en: Let's make your dad's favorite — loin katsu.
lines.style: Warm and practical. She's shifted from his wants to the family's. Soft domestic certainty. The small tenderness of feeding someone you know well.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: アイドルのファンクラブに、お姉ちゃん、入ってるよ。
lines.en: Your sister joined an idol fan club, you know.
lines.style: Light, almost observational. A small piece of news offered gently. The cadence of a mother noticing what her children notice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 明日、家族連れで、動物園、行きましょう。
lines.en: Tomorrow we'll all go to the zoo together as a family.
lines.style: Warm close with quiet resolution. Gathering all the scattered wants into one family plan. Gentle assurance — the yes she's been building toward all along.
